Description

2020 Bowman Draft is a 200-card set released December 7th. Each Hobby only Jumbo will contain three autographs, 24 Refractors, a box topper, and eleven inserts, while Super Jumbo boxes will yield five signatures and 40 Refractors.

1st Edition

As a follow-up to the successful 2020 Bowman 1st Edition, on November 18th Topps released 2020 Bowman Draft 1st Edition. 1st Edition featured the full 200-card base set with each card, all printed on paper cardstock, stamped with a "1st Edition" logo -- similar to Bowman releases in 2004 and 2005. Ten-card packs retailed for $14.99 each with 24-pack boxes also available on a first-come first-served basis.

Distribution

Jumbo: 32 cards per pack, 12 packs per box. Eight boxes per case. Hobby only.

Super Jumbo: 120 cards per pack, five packs per box. Six boxes per case. Hobby only.

Sapphire Edition

The 2020 Bowman Chrome Draft Sapphire Edition was released exclusively via topps.com on January 7th, 2021, with members of the 582 Montgomery Club getting it two days earlier. Each 32 card box, which retailed for $70 (double the price of the previous year's product), will contain two parallels serial-numbered to 99 copies or fewer. 22,500 boxes were sold with a production of 3375 copies for each base card -- both slight increases from 2019.

Each card is available in the following parallels.

  • Yellow Sapphire (serial-numbered to 99 copies)
  • Green Sapphire (serial-numbered to 50 copies)
  • Orange Sapphire (serial-numbered to 25 copies)
  • Aqua Sapphire (serial-numbered to 20 copies)
  • Gold Sapphire (serial-numbered to fifteen)
  • Purple Sapphire (serial-numbered to ten)
  • Red Sapphire (serial-numbered to five)
  • Padparadscha (one-of-one)
